statusDetail: Cloudflare managed bot verification returned HTTP 403 and remained on “Performing security verification” after browser waits; the origin content, routes, and representative user flows were not reachable.

page.notes: Only the Cloudflare managed challenge was reachable; origin application profile could not be established.
